findings.title: Missing GRANTs on public.mascots table
findings.description: The 'public.mascots' table was created but lacks explicit GRANT statements for 'authenticated' and 'service_role' roles.

findings.title: Missing RLS on public.mascots table
findings.description: Row Level Security (RLS) is not enabled on the 'public.mascots' table, making it potentially accessible to unauthorized roles if grants were added incorrectly.
